title: "Check the inclusion and exclusion of studies using different metadata sources"
author: "Laura Andrea Barrero Guevara"

####################################################################################################
Purpose: To create a data frame with the included studies and verify if the reasons for excluding 
studies can be substantiated by other metadata sources.

Output:
- `stu_included.rds`: Data frame containing GSK studies that are included. 
####################################################################################################

# Set wd to project directory
```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '~/Nextcloud/Projects/_seas_imm/code_exp_imm')
```

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
source("00_pck.R")
# Load functions to read gsk dfs and tidy names
source("fun_data/fun_dgsk_readdfs.R")
source("fun_data/fun_dgsk_tidynames.R")
```

# Load data 
```{r}
# Load data frame of requested and received studies
stu_req <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_req.rds"))
# Load metadata sourced from GSK
stu_meta_gsk <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_meta_gsk.rds"))
# Load metadata sourced from clinicaltrialsgov
stu_meta_ctgov <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_meta_ctgov.rds"))
# Load metadata sourced from protocols
stu_meta_pro <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_meta_pro.rds")) %>%
  rename(excluded = exclusion)
# Load data on missing data frames
stu_missingdfs <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_missingdfs.rds")) 
```

# Check excluded studies (according to protocol metadata)
```{r}
exclusions <- list()
# Filter out studies that do not fulfill population criteria
# Exclusions: Pre-term infants, high-risk groups, HIV positive, Novartis trials
# Result: 14 studies
exclusions$pop <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  filter(excluded == "Excluded for all" & 
           str_detect(reason, "Pre-term|High-risk|HIV|Novartis|Teenagers"))

# Filter out studies due to missing data, excluding Novartis trials
# Exclusions: Missing data (no data, no serological data, no dates, no exposure data, no age data,
# no antibody measurements with missing dates)
# Result: 26 studies
exclusions$dat <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  filter(excluded == "Excluded for all", str_detect(reason, "Novartis", negate = TRUE),
           str_detect(reason, "No data|No sero|No dates|No expo|No age|No ab men and no dates"))

# Filter out studies due to missing data in the primary study
# Exclusions: No primary study data available
# Result: 23 studies
exclusions$pri <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  filter(excluded == "Excluded for all" & str_detect(reason, "No primary \\(no av|No primary \\(av")) 

# Filter out studies permissive of previous routine vaccination 
# Exclusions: Studies with previous routine vaccination (the enrolling criteria requested previous
# vaccinations or allowed previous vaccinations, so the study is not primary)
# Result: 15 studies
exclusions$rou <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  filter(excluded == "Excluded for all" & str_detect(reason, "No primary \\(routine")) 

# Filter out repeated studies
# Exclusions: Follow-up studies, studies added to other trials, 
# contained within other studies, or booster studies
# Result: 66 studies
exclusions$rep <- stu_meta_pro %>%
  filter(excluded == "Excluded for all" & str_detect(reason, "Follow up|Added to|Contained|Booster"))
```

# Prepare inclusion criteria data frame from the metadata sourced from clinicaltrialsgov 
```{r}
# Get names of studies and containing folders into named vector
stu_l <- stu_req$stu_pat_tidy
names(stu_l) <- stu_req$study

# Prepare additional notes data frame from the metadata sourced from gsk 
stu_linked <- stu_meta_gsk %>%
  select(study, add) %>%
  rename(stu_linked = add) %>%
  ## Use points to separate notes and pivot long 
  mutate(stu_linked = str_replace_all(tolower(stu_linked), "clinicaltrials.gov", "clinicaltrials")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(stu_linked, delim = ". ") %>%
  # Select only notes with numbers (from the study ids of the linked studies)
  mutate(stu_linked = case_when(str_detect(stu_linked, "[0-9]") ~ stu_linked)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stu_linked)) %>%
  distinct(study, stu_linked) %>%
  # Create add_def to define type of link
  mutate(
    stu_linked = str_remove(stu_linked,"\\."),
    stu_linked_def = case_when(
      # Main study linked to secondary studies
      str_detect(stu_linked, "follow-on") ~ "follow-on",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "conducted") & str_detect(stu_linked, "follow-up") ~ "follow-on",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "conducted") & str_detect(stu_linked, "booster") ~ "booster-on",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "conducted") & str_detect(stu_linked, "extension") ~ "extension-on",
      # Secondary studies linked to main study
      str_detect(stu_linked, "this is a") & str_detect(stu_linked, "follow-up") ~ "follow-up",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "conducted") & str_detect(stu_linked, "persistence") ~ "persistence-on",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "this is a|this study is") & str_detect(stu_linked, "booster") ~ "booster-up",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "this is a") & str_detect(stu_linked, "extension") ~ "extension-up",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "this is a") & str_detect(stu_linked, "persistence") ~ "persistence-up",
      str_detect(stu_linked, "summarise") ~ "summarised"),
    # Rename linked studies names and take out years
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "ipv-018 \\(112679\\)", "112679"),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "v12p13e1", "205453"),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "v72p13", "205450"),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "year 10|year 2|year 3|year 4|year 1", ""),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "\\(.*?\\)", ""),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "follow-up|follow-on", ""),
    # Obtain linked studies ids
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "/", "-000000-"),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "[^0-9]+", "_"),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "^_|_$", ""),
    stu_linked = str_replace_all(stu_linked, "_000000_", "-")) 

# Prepare inclusion criteria data frame from the metadata sourced from clinicaltrialsgov 
stu_criteria <- stu_meta_ctgov %>%
  select(study, 
         protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria) %>%
  rename(inclusion = protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria) %>%
  mutate(
    inclusion = str_remove_all(tolower(inclusion), "\n|\\*"),
    exclusion = str_remove_all(inclusion,".*exclusion|criteria: "),
    inclusion = str_remove_all(inclusion,"exclusion.*|inclusion criteria: "))
```

# 1. Check studies that do not fulfill population criteria
```{r}
# Create list of checks
checks <- list()
checks$pop <- exclusions$pop %>%
  select(study, classification, excluded, reason) %>%
  left_join(stu_criteria, by = join_by(study)) %>%
  left_join(select(stu_meta_ctgov, study, 
                   protocolSection.identificationModule.organization.fullName), by = join_by(study)) %>%
  rename(organization = protocolSection.identificationModule.organization.fullName) %>%
  mutate(pre_term = str_detect(inclusion, "pre-term"),
         hiv = str_detect(inclusion, "hiv"),
         risk = str_detect(inclusion, "risk"),
         novartis = organization == "Novartis")

# Exceptions
 checks$pop %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  filter(!any(c(pre_term, hiv, risk, novartis)))
 
# Studies 205240 and 205249 were previously Novartis studies, therefore they are excluded as well. 
# See https://www.gsk-studyregister.com/en/trial-details/?id=205240 (protocol)
# See https://www.gsk-studyregister.com/en/trial-details/?id=205249 (clinical study report)
# Study 103860-280 (and followed up) included only children over 10 yrs old 
# See https://www.gsk-studyregister.com/en/trial-details/?id=101695%20Ext.%20Mth30
```

# 2. Check studies with missing data
```{r}
checks$dat <- exclusions$dat %>%
  select(study, classification, excluded, reason) %>%
  left_join(stu_missingdfs, by = join_by(study)) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_data = reason == "No data" & is.na(pathogen),
    missing_sero = str_detect(reason, "No sero file") & sero_cod == 0,
    missing_dates = str_detect(reason, "No dates file") & dates == 0)

# Exceptions (no exceptions)
checks$dat %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  filter(!any(c(missing_data, missing_sero, missing_dates)))
```

# 3. Check studies with missing data in the primary study
```{r}
checks$pri <- exclusions$pri %>%
  select(study, classification, excluded, reason, study_main) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(study_main, delim = "_") %>%
  left_join(stu_missingdfs, by = join_by(study_main == study)) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_data = str_detect(reason, "No primary \\(no av") & is.na(pathogen),
    missing_sero = str_detect(reason, "no sero") & sero_cod == 0,
    missing_dates = str_detect(reason, "no dates")  & dates == 0)

# Exceptions
checks$pri %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  filter(!any(c(missing_data, missing_sero, missing_dates)))

# Study 115375, the pid does not coincide with that of 105539, also not in the protocols.
left_join(fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l["115375"], cdi = FALSE)$pid %>%
            select(pid, cty_nam, group_nb),
          fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l["105539"], cdi = FALSE)$pid %>%
            select(pid, cty_nam, group_nb), by = join_by(pid))
```

# 4. Check studies permissive of previous routine vaccination 
```{r}
# First obtain the vaccines administered in this studies (according to the data)
checks$rou <- list()
# For each study, read data frames, get vaccine names and tidy up vaccine names
for(stu_id in exclusions$rou$study) {
  # Define if CDI format 
  if(stu_id %in% c("115648", "115158", "115649", "115461", "201532")) cdi <- TRUE else cdi <- FALSE
  # Identify vaccine names
  if(cdi == FALSE) { 
    checks$rou[[stu_id]] <- distinct(fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l[stu_id], cdi = cdi)$expo, vaccine) 
    } else { 
    checks$rou[[stu_id]] <- distinct(rename(fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l[stu_id], cdi = cdi)$expo, 
                                            vaccine = aextrt), vaccine) }
  checks$rou[[stu_id]] <- fun_dgsk_tidynames(checks$rou[[stu_id]], study = stu_id, tidynames = "vaccine") 
}

# Assess if for all the vaccines administered, the inclusion criteria was permissive of previous
# vaccination (so that the hole study is excluded).
# The intention is to check that the routine vaccines are actually the study vaccines, if that is 
# the case, exclude. 
checks$rou <- bind_rows(checks$rou) %>%
  mutate(vaccine = vaccine_tidy) %>%
  mutate(vaccine = case_when(
    vaccine %in% c("priorix vaccine") ~ "mmr",
    vaccine %in% c("varilrix vaccine") ~ "vzv",
    vaccine %in% c("memuru-oka vaccine") ~ "mmr_vzv",
    vaccine %in% c("dtpw-hbv-ipv/hib") ~ "dtp_hbv_ipv_hib",
    vaccine %in% c("dtpw_hbv/hiberix") ~ "dtp_hbv_hib",
    vaccine %in% c("boostrix","dtpa") ~ "dtp",
    vaccine %in% c("dtpa_ipv vaccine") ~ "dtp_ipv",
    study == "213503-050" ~ "dtp_ipv_hib",
    study == "263855-035" & vaccine == "treatment a" ~ "dtp",
    .default = vaccine)) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(vaccine, delim = "_") %>%
  mutate(vaccine = str_replace_all(vaccine, "dtpa", "dtp"),
         vaccine = str_replace_all(vaccine, "ipv", "polio")) %>%
  # Two NA expected from study 711866-001 and 213503-046 that reported no vaccination as NA
  filter(!is.na(vaccine)) %>%
  distinct(study, vaccine) %>%
  right_join(select(exclusions$rou, study, inclusion_criteria), by = join_by(study)) %>%
  mutate(inclusion_criteria = str_remove_all(inclusion_criteria, "F |\\(|\\)")) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(inclusion_criteria, delim = "_") %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(noprimary = vaccine %in% inclusion_criteria)
  
# Exceptions
checks$rou %>%
  filter(noprimary != TRUE)

# Study 263855-035, had routine vaccination for dtp and no ab measurements for hav 
fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l["263855-035"], cdi = FALSE)$sero %>%
  distinct(seroname)
```
Note: The inclusion criteria recorded in the protocols metadata was manually extracted from both the 
protocols and the clinicaltrials.gov. 

# 5. Check studies repeated
The studies can have data within studies because they are follow ups, booster, extensions, 
persistence studies or added for analyses. The gsk preliminary data has some information of the 
linked studies. We compare the information to that extracted from the protocols. 
```{r}
checks$rep <- exclusions$rep %>%
  select(study, study_type, study_main, excluded, reason) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(study_main, delim = "_") %>%
  left_join(stu_linked, by = join_by(study), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  separate_longer_delim(stu_linked, delim = "_") %>%
  group_by(study, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(main_linked = study_main %in% stu_linked) 

# Exceptions (29 studies were not linked in the gsk metadata, but where linked later when comparing 
# their protocols and the data)
checks$rep %>%
  filter(!any(main_linked)) %>%
  group_by(across(c(-study_main))) %>%
  summarise(study_main = str_c(study_main, collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Extra: Check if there are studies linked to other studies (repeated) according to the metadata 
# sourced from GSK that were missed from the metadata sourced from the protocols.
```{r}
# Compare with protocol data 
stu_linked %>%
  # Compare with protocol data 
  right_join(stu_meta_pro, by = join_by(study)) %>%
  select(study, study_type, study_main, excluded, reason, stu_linked, stu_linked_def) %>%
  # Select studies that have linked studies in the gsk preliminary data, that do not coincided with 
  # the information in the protocol, are not the same study, and the linked studies were actually
  # requested 
  filter(!is.na(stu_linked) & 
           !((str_detect(reason, "Follow up|Added to|Contained|Booster") & str_detect(stu_linked, study_main)) |
             (str_detect(reason, "Follow up|Added to|Contained|Booster") & str_detect(study_main, stu_linked)))) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(stu_linked, delim = "_") %>%
  filter(stu_linked != study) %>%
  filter(stu_linked %in% stu_meta_gsk$study) %>%
  # Add information on exclusion for the linked studies 
  left_join(select(stu_meta_pro, study, excluded, reason) %>%
              rename(stu_linked = study, stu_linked_excluded = excluded, stu_linked_reason = reason),
            by = join_by(stu_linked)) %>%
  # Filter out linked studies excluded for follow-up/added/contained
  filter(!str_detect(stu_linked_reason, "Follow up|Added to|Contained|Booster")) %>%
  # Filter out linked studies excluded because primary was not available
  filter(!str_detect(stu_linked_reason, "no av")) %>%
  # Filter out linked studies exclude because of lack of data
  filter(!str_detect(stu_linked_reason, "No sero|no sero|No dates|no dates")) %>%
  # Only studies that have not been excluded already for another reason
  filter(excluded != "Excluded for all")

# Study 105553 has a follow-up (112640), but this is seems to be a mistake in the database.
left_join(fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l["105553"], cdi = FALSE)$pid %>%
            select(pid, cty_nam, group_nb),
          fun_dgsk_readdfs(study = stu_l["112640"], cdi = FALSE)$pid %>%
            select(pid, cty_nam, group_nb), by = join_by(pid))

# Study 347414-029 is a follow up of 347414-017, but in the follow up they vaccinated for the first
# time against mmr. We do not exclude the complete follow up, but we excluded the no primary vaccines. 
```

# Create studies included df and save it  
```{r}
stu_included <- mutate(stu_req, included = !(study %in% bind_rows(exclusions)$study))
saveRDS(stu_included, file = glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_included.rds"))
```
